input.description: Hardcoded production/sensitive credentials in workflow env block
input.evidence: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and DATABASE_PASSWORD hardcoded in job env block in .github/workflows/deploy.yml
input.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and inject them securely using GitHub Actions secrets (${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}, etc.).

input.evidence: PYPI_API_TOKEN and DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN hardcoded in job env block in .github/workflows/release.yml
input.description: Hardcoded sensitive API tokens in workflow env block
input.recommendation: Remove hardcoded tokens and use GitHub Actions encrypted secrets instead.

input.description: Secrets echoed and printed to workflow logs
input.recommendation: Remove debugging steps that output secrets or tokens to the workflow console logs.
input.evidence: echo statements and printenv | grep -i token printing secrets in .github/workflows/ci.yml

input.recommendation: Remove set -x / set -ex from steps handling sensitive environment variables or secrets.
input.evidence: set -x enabled before running commands referencing sensitive environment variables in .github/workflows/deploy.yml
input.description: Bash debug mode (set -x / set -ex) expanding secrets in logs

input.evidence: curl -v / --verbose used with authorization headers in deploy.yml and release.yml
input.description: Verbose HTTP requests (curl -v) exposing authorization headers in logs
input.recommendation: Remove --verbose or -v flags from curl commands that include authorization headers or sensitive payloads.
Pass secrets via environment variables or configuration files rather than command-line arguments where they can appear in process lists.
input.evidence: npm publish --token=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }} passes secret as CLI flag in .github/workflows/ci.yml

input.recommendation: Exclude sensitive configuration files, environment files, and private keys from workflow artifacts.
input.description: Sensitive files and private keys uploaded as CI/CD artifacts
input.evidence: Uploading .env, credentials.json, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, and private keys as workflow artifacts in .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml
None of the workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml) define a permissions block.
input.description: Missing top-level permissions block in GitHub Actions workflows
input.recommendation: Define explicit least-privilege permissions blocks at the workflow or job level.

input.description: Publish/release job running without prerequisite test or build validation jobs
input.recommendation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on passing test and build jobs before executing release or publish jobs.
input.evidence: release.yml runs publish job on release published without requiring a test job or dependency check

input.summary: Audited the repository and identified critical and high severity DevOps and security violations across GitHub Actions workflows, including hardcoded production secrets and tokens in workflow environment blocks, secret exposure through console echo and printenv, bash debug mode (set -x) expanding secrets, verbose HTTP curl calls logging authorization headers, secrets passed as command-line arguments, upload of private keys and .env files as artifacts, missing workflow permissions blocks, and publishing jobs executing without testing prerequisites.
